pretreatments.description: Thermal pretreatment at 50 °C for 30 min, followed by 80 °C for 30 min, and finally 120 °C for 30 min using a water bath. Also, thermal pretreatment at 120 °C for 30 min using an autoclave.
Ultrasonic pretreatment for 30, 90, or 180 s using an ultrasonicator (VCX-130) with a power of 130 W.
Alkali pretreatment adjusted to pH 9, 11, or 13 using 5 N NaOH.
